# Expected output (Module 7 step 5 fallback; regenerated by maintainers before each delivery)

Participants without an `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` repository secret read these instead of running the CI gate:

| File | What it shows |
|---|---|
| `pr-comment.png` | the inline review comment `claude-code-security-review` leaves on `app/users.py` at the `fetch_avatar(url)` call (SSRF, CWE-918) |
| `security-review-run.log` | the Action's run log: findings count, artifact upload |
| `security-review-transcript.md` | `/security-review` output on `feat/avatar-proxy` (single pass, markdown, no files) |
| `change-scan-transcript.md` | `/claude-security scan my branch --effort low` on the same branch: confirmation, phases, Coverage note, SSRF finding |

Regenerate on the instructor's copy of the template after pushing `feat/avatar-proxy` and opening the PR (M7 step 5).
